# Cose di Casa semantic fixtures

These are authored, minimal HTML fixtures using the observed primary-wrapper, row, time and self-Event structures. They are not saved publisher pages or copied editorial articles. Event names, locations, date/hour facts and source timestamps are retained to test their meaning; body sentences are short factual paraphrases and contacts are examples.

The manifest records the five complete public source reads of 20 October 2026, their hashes and observed transport URLs. The parser was replayed against those complete pages in scratch. Every fixture preserves the same relevant location, hours, calendar intervals, selected dates, rules, suspensions and conflict codes. Transport final URLs remain distinct from canonical links.
